summary: On the main deck the crew breaks up after watching the jump. Mouse asks what it means and Switch says it means nothing, while Cypher taunts Trinity about Neo falling 'the first time'; Trinity has already left. Neo's eyes open as Tank eases the plug out of him; he groans and cradles his ribs. While Tank helps Morpheus, Neo spits blood into his hand. Neo, having believed the Matrix wasn't real, is told by Morpheus that 'your mind makes it real,' and after staring at the blood he asks whether death in the Matrix means death here, to which Morpheus replies 'the body cannot live without the mind.'

what_changes.before: believes the Matrix isn't real and that injury there is not real
what_changes.after: confronted with the reality of his own blood and the rule that mind governs body
what_changes.evidence: NEO: I thought it wasn't real. MORPHEUS: Your mind makes it real. Neo stares at the blood.
Neo's eyes open as Tank eases the plug out. He tries to move and groans, cradling his ribs.

event_hint.one_line: After Neo's failed first jump, the crew disperses and Morpheus teaches Neo that the Matrix's dangers are real because the mind makes them so.

uncertain: Whether Trinity leaves out of irritation at Cypher's taunt or simply to attend to Neo.
